prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit with immutable canonical identities. First images are canonical portraits, next is the engineering ROOM reference, LAST exact target. Preserve exact facial morphology, eyes, noses, jaws, adult ages, expressions, hairstyles, skin, body poses and continuous two-arm chains, natural grips and furniture contact. Preserve cinematic adventure-comic staging and room geometry. Farah lens anatomical LEFT eye; Demir comms anatomical RIGHT ear. Keep natural short necks. Every unspecified rear, side and wrist screen is inactive charcoal glass, no decorative graphs or fake code. Retain physical buttons. Muted sage interfaces and aged brass, no neon mint, fluorescent lime or broad mustard wash. Warm engineering lamps remain local. Preserve Demir exact face, expression and natural stylus/edge grips. Slightly reduce his complete head by only about5 percent, retaining exact facial proportions and a natural short neck. Tablet becomes a compact legible table headed "Synthetic evaluation" with four rows: "Actual 10 20 30 40"; "LSTM 12 18 30 40"; "Attention 8 22 30 40"; "Kalman 10 20 33 37". Under the table a separate short line "Prior errors: 0.045, 0.038, 0.058". Footer "Member and blend MAEs: pending" and "Beats best: pending". No calculated output or success badge. Keep exact row order and pair values. Other screens and wrist terminal off. Clean bold linework, flat cel shading, slight adult stylization, cinematic character framing. Output one full 1536x1024 scene only.
